docs.title: Tally Prime & GST Mastery Path
docs.text:
Mastery Path BOOTCAMP VINOD BHANUJA

A structured, module-wise accounting program that takes you from the golden rules of accounting to running a full year of books and compliance in TallyPrime — with step-by-step instructions, shortcut cheat sheets, and a hands-on exercise in every module.

It's built for commerce students, junior accountants, small-business owners and anyone preparing for an accounts job in India. Every lesson uses a practice company and worked numbers, so you can follow along inside TallyPrime and check your answers.

docs.title: How the program is organized
docs.text: Level Focus Modules Level 1 · Entry Golden rules, TallyPrime basics, ledgers and groups, vouchers, sales and purchases, inventory, bank reconciliation, core reports, GST fundamentals 9 topics + 1 project Level 2 · Intermediate GST setup, GST invoicing, ITC and GSTR-2B, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, credit and debit notes, e-invoicing and e-way bills, RCM and composition, bill-wise tracking, cost centres 9 topics + 1 project Level 3 · Advanced TDS, TCS, payroll with PF and ESI, advanced inventory, manufacturing, banking utilities, foreign currency and exports, year-end adjustments, GSTR-9 9 topics + 1 project Level 4 · Master Ratio analysis, MIS reporting, internal controls and audit trail, data management, compliance calendar, MSME accounting, moving to ERP, practice and freelancing, career 9 topics + 1 capstone

docs.title: How to use this site
docs.text:
• Work through each level in order — later modules use the practice company you build earlier.
  • Every topic page has numbered steps with exact TallyPrime screens and keyboard shortcuts, plus worked figures you can check.
  • Each topic ends with a cheat sheet and an Exercise.
  • Each level ends with a project, and Level 4 ends with a capstone covering a full financial year.
  • Tax rates and thresholds change. Each lesson states the rule as of 2026 — always confirm the latest notifications on gst.gov.in and incometax.gov.in before filing real returns.

Start here → Level 1 · Entry

docs.title: What you'll need
docs.text:
TallyPrime installed on Windows (the free Educational Mode is enough for every exercise — it limits voucher dates, not features) and a calculator or spreadsheet for checking figures. No prior accounting knowledge is assumed. For real GST filing you would also need a GSTIN and GST portal login, but the course uses practice data throughout.
